test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question: Under which initiative has the Government launched the ‘Kaushal Rath’ mobile programme to promote AI literacy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuva AI for All.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched ‘Kaushal Rath’ under the National AI Literacy programme “Yuva AI for All”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Kaushal Rath is a mobile AI awareness initiative under “Yuva AI for All”.**
 
• The programme aims to democratise foundational AI education across semi-urban and underserved regions.
 
• The mobile unit is equipped with internet-enabled systems and hands-on AI training modules.
 
• The initiative is part of the broader IndiaAI Mission to build an AI-ready workforce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Yuva AI for All__

 __
 
• A National AI Literacy programme focused on students and youth.
 
• Offers a four-hour self-paced course covering AI basics, ethics and applications.
 
 
 
• IndiaAI Mission__
 __
 
• A government initiative with seven core pillars including AI skilling.
 
• Aims to position India as a global leader in responsible AI development.
 
 
 
• Kaushal Rath__
 __
 
• A mobile AI-enabled digital lab.
 
• Travels to schools, colleges and ITIs to promote AI literacy.
 
 
 
• India AI Impact Summit 2026__
 
 
• Scheduled to be held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
 
• Focuses on AI outcomes aligned with People, Planet and Progress.
